en: Color postcard showing a wide modern avenue lined with socialist‑era apartment blocks. On the left stands a long green multi‑storey hospital building (Slatina Hospital). Pedestrians walk on sidewalks; a few 1970s vehicles are on the street. The reverse has a Romanian handwritten message dated 11 II 1975, a 40 B 'Posta Romana – Densus' stamp with a Bucuresti cancellation, and printed credits from Editura Meridiane.
